NSIS contributors: core functionality and zlib compression only, full upstream notices in ../licenses/nsis.txt. No external nsis-resources plug-ins are embedded.

Changes in 1.5.1 (2026-10-20): retain native CPU inference in a background worker; rebuild Windows Node binding without GPU providers against the official CPU runtime; make Node/Common JS imports relative; replace old NNUE with the explicitly CC0 Fairy-Stockfish network; bundle GPL C++ sources, build instructions and notices; remove third-party game screenshots from public source distribution.
